code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Repeat the seed pattern above the full-width separator into the blank area below.
    sep=next((i for i,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]==0), None)
    if sep is None:
        return g
    seed=g[:sep]
    for r in range(sep+1,len(g)):
        g[r]=seed[(r-sep-1)%len(seed)][:]
    return g
'''
